headline: Beyoncé and Kelly Rowland Open Rebuilt Houston Youth Center
meta_description: Beyoncé and Kelly Rowland celebrate the reopening of Houston's Knowles-Rowland House, rebuilt after a 2021 fire, now providing 31 permanent homes.
summary_short: A youth center co-funded by Beyoncé and Kelly Rowland has reopened in Houston after being destroyed by fire, now housing 31 residents.
body:
Beyoncé and Kelly Rowland have celebrated the opening of the rebuilt Knowles-Rowland House in Houston, a youth center they helped fund that was destroyed in a 2021 fire.

The nonprofit Bread of Life spearheaded the reconstruction effort, transforming the center into a facility that now provides 31 permanent homes. The project represents both a recovery from loss and a renewed commitment to serve vulnerable young people in Houston.

The reopening marks a significant milestone for the community, restoring a vital resource that had been damaged years earlier and expanding its capacity to house those in need.

Original center destroyed in a 2021 fire
Nonprofit Bread of Life rebuilt the facility
Rebuilt center now provides 31 permanent homes
